title: Introduction
desc: What designme.dev is: free components for AI agent products, in HTML, React or Astro, in two styles with light and dark mode.

title: Installation
desc: Add components with the designme CLI or the shadcn CLI, as HTML, CSS and JavaScript, React or Astro, and give them your Tailwind v4 theme.

title: Astro
desc: Add the components to an Astro project as .astro files, with the same markup, CSS and script as the HTML version.

title: Theming
desc: Switch between Soft and Blueprint, light and dark, and set your own accent and its roles.

title: Accessibility
desc: The roles, keyboard support, touch tap areas, reduced motion and contrast work built into the components.

title: Using with AI
desc: Point a coding agent at the Markdown copy of every page and at llms.txt, and prompt it to install components with the CLI.
